description: List what search_stays accepts: the regions (north, south, center and their sub-regions), the cities that have at least one public listing, the categories and the amenities, each with its slug and a localized name; the search limits (max_nights, max_adults, max_children, max_infants); today in Israel; the accepted payment methods and customer clubs (clubs: ILS checkouts only); the currencies and locales. Call it once before searching when you need a valid region_slug, city_slug, category or amenities slug, and call it when the guest asks whether their club card gets a discount. Facts only, no prices; cached, so a new city or amenity can take up to a day to appear. Read-only.

locale.description: Language of the region, city, category and amenity names (he, en, fr, es, de, it, ru, ar). Defaults to he.

name: get_search_options
